notes.title: Season 2 of the YouRiding Bodyboard World Tour is Here! New Waves, New Thrills!
notes.content:
Bodyboarders, get ready! The highly anticipated second season of the YouRiding Bodyboard World Tour is about to kick off, and it’s bigger and better than ever. With 8 fresh waves and a thrilling new roster, the global competition is set to elevate virtual bodyboarding to new heights.

[previewyoutube=Mn1SYKeZRdM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Season, New Waves[/h1]

Following the intense competition of last season, we’re taking the action to entirely new waters. This year’s world tour will feature 8 unique and challenging waves from around the globe, giving players a chance to showcase their skills in fresh environments:
[list]
[*]Palm Beach – Gold Coast, Australia
[*]Cave Rock – South Africa
[*]El Frontón – Canary Islands, Spain
[*]Shark Bay – Ecuador
[*]Petacalco – Mexico
[*]Aussie Pipe – Australia
[*]La Tortue – Reunion Island
[*]Riley's – Ireland
[/list]

Each competition will push riders to their limits as they battle to rack up points and climb the global rankings.

[h1]Divisions Rebalanced – Let the Competition Begin![/h1]

After the results of last season, players have been promoted or relegated within the divisions, ensuring balanced and intense competition across the board. Last year’s world champion, JDR, will be back to defend their title, but they’ll face fierce challengers hungry for victory. Can JDR hold onto the crown, or will a new champ emerge this season?

[h1]Special Guest Host: Manny Vargas[/h1]

We’re beyond stoked to announce that bodyboarding legend Manny Vargas is joining this season as our special guest host! A former professional bodyboarder and the voice behind some of the biggest events on the real-world tour, Manny will be making exclusive videos to present and summarize each event. With his insider knowledge and unmatched enthusiasm, Manny will bring the tour to life like never before.

[h1]Real-World Partnerships for the Ultimate Bodyboard Experience[/h1]

We’re also continuing to bridge the gap between virtual and real-world bodyboarding by partnering with real-life competitions. The season opener at Palm Beach (Gold Coast) is in collaboration with Goldcoast Future Pros, and the iconic El Frontón event will run alongside the prestigious Gran Canaria Fronton King competition. These partnerships make the virtual tour feel even more connected to the real sport, giving players the chance to compete in sync with real-world bodyboarders.

[h1]Join the Action![/h1]

The first event of the season at Palm Beach, Gold Coast, kicks off soon. Are you ready to ride the waves, earn points, and take your division by storm? Stay tuned for Manny Vargas’ event previews and updates, and get ready to make your mark in the world of competitive bodyboarding!

Catch the latest season, join the competition, and chase the world championship – this is bodyboarding like never before! 🌊🏄‍♂️ #YouRidingWorldTour #Bodyboarding #neverstopriding

[b]The YouRiding Team[/b]

notes.title: YouRiding teams up with omnislash for epic video and screenshot capture
notes.content:
[h1]Riding the Virtual Wave with YouRiding and omni/[/h1]
Get stoked because YouRiding is about to get even more epic! We've partnered up with omni/ to make sure you don't miss a single moment of your raddest surf sessions. Now, every crazy barrel and sick trick can be captured effortlessly while you ride the waves in the game.

[h1]What's in it for You:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic Awesomeness:[/b] Forget hitting a dozen keys to capture your moves – omni/ does it for you! Enjoy the thrill of surfing without worrying about missing that perfect wave or trick.

[*][b]Share the Stoke:[/b] We get it; you want to show off your skills. omni/ makes it a breeze to share your coolest moments with your crew. From massive waves to killer tricks, let the world see how you own the virtual surf!

[*][b]One-Click Sharing:[/b] No need to be a tech whiz. omni/ hooks you up with easy sharing on your favorite socials and gaming communities. Share the stoke with just a click – it's as simple as dropping in on a wave.

[*][b]Connect with the Crew:[/b] Surfing is better with friends! omni/ not only captures your moments but makes it easy to connect with other virtual wave riders. Share tips, learn new tricks, and become part of the YouRiding community.
[/list]

[h1]New Game-Changing Feature: Capture the Perfect Shot![/h1]
We've added a rad new feature to amp up your photo game. Now, you can pause the game mid-surf, giving you the freedom to move the camera around to find the best angle for that jaw-dropping screenshot. Take control, find your perfect shot, and make your virtual surf memories truly unforgettable.

[h1]Available Now on Windows with Update v0.7.0![/h1]
Ready to ride the omni/ wave? This new feature is live and kicking, available exclusively on Windows with the latest YouRiding update v0.7.0. So, Windows surfers, grab your boards, update your game, and dive into the ultimate surf experience!

For more details on omni/ and the game-changing features, ride the wave over to [url=https://omnislash.com/?utm_campaign=sdk&utm_medium=game&utm_content=steamnews&utm_source=youriding]omni/ Website[/url]. Get ready to ride the virtual wave like never before. It's time to share the stoke, showcase your skills, and be part of the most epic surf community in gaming!

The YouRiding Crew

notes.title: YouRiding is officially released
notes.content:
We opened the game a year ago and thanks to your feedback we were able to make lots of improvements: much better graphics, a multiplayer mode, the basics of the shop and we improved many other things.

We still have a lot more to add but it is time to officially release the game, and not only on Steam but also on mobile devices!

[h1]Available platforms[/h1]
You can now find the game on:
[list]
[*]Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725680/YouRiding__Surfing_and_Bodyboarding_Game/]click here[/url]
[*]iOS: [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/youriding-surf-and-bodyboard/id1586421941]click here[/url]
[*]Android: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.boardscore.youriding]click here[/url]
[/list]

The game is fully cross-platform so all your progression on one device will continue on the other one and you can play against players coming from any platform.
We might add more platforms in a near future.

[h1]Not free-to-play anymore[/h1]
Some former YouRiding players might be disappointed the game is not free like it used to be.
Before, you were able to download the game for free but you had to pay for all the content inside the game and we were also showing you lots of ads.
Now the game has a small price to pay but everything inside the game is available for free and there are no ads at all.

[h1]Why not doing the free-to-play anymore?[/h1]
The answer is simple: in free-to-play, we have to design the game to generate revenue and it forces us to make decisions that usually go against the fun. By removing this constraint we can make a game that's fun to play without looking for money at every single corner.

[h1]I bought the game on Steam, can I have it on mobile?[/h1]
The answer is YES if you bought the game in Early Access. Contact us at [i]support@youriding.gg[/i] or via our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8GRFtWR]Discord[/url].

[h1]What is coming up next?[/h1]
Here is the current roadmap:
[list]
[*]XP Progression: earn XP by riding waves and competing in multiplayers, and unlock equipment in the shop by reaching certains levels of XP.
[*]New shop and real brands: we are redesigning the shop and working with brands to include their products in the shop.
[*]Journey challenges: we are building a feature letting you create a challenge like it was in the Journey. You can pick a list of waves and build challenges to make on each one of them, then share it to the community. Players will have to finish the first challenge to unlock the next one and so on until they are done with the whole challenge. Using that feature and the wave editor you could potentially rebuild the Journey entirely!
[*]Championships: YouRiding is not YouRiding if we don't have worldwide championships! So that will be added next with official championships that will crown the YouRiding world champion! (is JDR going to win?)
[/list]

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8GRFtWR]Discord[/url] if you want to learn more about these features or suggest new ones!

Thanks a lot for your support and never stop riding!
Mike

notes.title: Update 0.0.20
notes.content:
Boards are now giving you attributes that change how you ride the wave. There are 5 attributes:
[list]
[*]Top speed: Changes how fast you can go. Going very fast can help you make difficult sections in the barrel.
[*]Speed control: This helps you having a better control over your speed by stalling and accelerating faster.
[*]Handling: A good handling will help you change direction faster and potentially be more precise in your timing.
[*]Balance: This attribute will make you lose less balance in the barrel and recover your balance faster.
[*]Maneuver: Thanks to this attribute you will lose less balance and speed when doing maneuvers.
[/list]

Other improvements:
[list]
[*]Bug fix: spot placement on the map not accurate on some screens.
[*]Bug fix: iOS: big empty margin at the bottom of the screen
[/list]

Next update will have some physics fixes and improvements, then we will implement the progression system!

The iOS version is currently in private BETA, contact us to get access to it!

Don't forget to report any bug or ideas to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8GRFtWR]Discord[/url].
